title: The Devouring Citadel
description: A buried fortress has begun to wake. Its halls are not merely decorated with monsters: the architecture itself is the fossilized body of an ancient predatory intelligence. Enter through its fanged gate, blind its iris engine, survive the brood below, and decide whether the Heart of Teeth should die, sleep, or awaken.

scenes.title: The Fanged Gate
scenes.text: The upper-left entrance is a colossal jaw worked into the stone. Each tooth is a portcullis spike. A warm exhalation rolls from the dark beyond.

options.label: Jam the jaw with fallen masonry

scenes.title: The Gate Bites Back
scenes.text: A stone tongue uncoils and the hinge-bones assemble into a four-legged sentinel.

scenes.title: Bridge Beneath the Upper Jaw
scenes.text: A narrow bridge crosses the throat-like shaft. Above it hang black rectangular vaults like sealed organs. Scratched arrows point toward an iris symbol.

scenes.title: The Black Reservoirs
scenes.text: Three tall chambers drink torchlight. The liquid inside is not water but perfectly reflective darkness. Something taps from within the walls.

options.label: Drain the reservoirs into the throat shaft

scenes.title: The Iris Engine
scenes.text: A circular mechanism rotates within the wall. Concentric bronze rings close around a wet black pupil. Every few seconds a pale beam sweeps the hall.

options.label: Blind the pupil with a mirror-bright shard

scenes.title: The Face in the Wall
scenes.text: A huge thorn-crowned face occupies the eastern wall. Its empty central socket is large enough to walk through. Whispered prayers emerge backward from its teeth.

scenes.title: The Central Spine
scenes.text: Rectangular halls intersect around a line of vertebra-like pillars. This is the dungeon's navigational hub. Every distant impact echoes through the floor as if through bone.

scenes.title: The Watcher Nest
scenes.text: Eyes protrude from a knot of horn, rope-like tendon, and masonry. They blink in different rhythms until one sees you; then all of them focus at once.

scenes.title: The Broken Chapel
scenes.text: A rectangular sanctuary has been half-swallowed by the surrounding flesh-stone. A kneeling skeletal custodian still grips a hexagonal seal.

scenes.title: The Vertebral Corridor
scenes.text: The central descent narrows into a long tiled hall. Every third floor slab flexes slightly. At the far end, a vertical slit of red light opens and closes like a gill.

options.label: Turn east toward the ocular cannon

scenes.title: The Ocular Cannon
scenes.text: A long stone tube protrudes from a swollen eye socket. It tracks movement in the lower halls. The mechanism is connected by a tendon-cable to the iris engine above.

options.label: Use the custodian seal to command it

scenes.title: The Last Custodian
scenes.text: A knight assembled from rib plates and riveted stone steps from a wall niche. It asks one question: 'Do you come to kill the sleeper?'

scenes.title: The Sealed Reliquary
scenes.text: A low western chamber contains tools made for operating on buildings: saws for stone nerves, clamps for doors, and a silver lens engraved with an iris.

scenes.title: The Lower Stairs
scenes.text: A ladder-like stair descends into the oldest portion of the citadel. The stone here pulses once every twelve breaths. Below, many small voices speak in perfect unison.

scenes.title: The Brood Pit
scenes.text: The lower edge of the fortress is clogged with eye-like cysts, circular mouths, and crawling juvenile forms. They defend a central flower of bone.

options.label: Feed them rations and move slowly
Use the iris lens to scatter light through the pit

scenes.title: The Brood Surges
scenes.text: The juvenile creatures pour over the floor in a wave of claws and wet stone.

scenes.title: The Pulse Before the Heart
scenes.text: The final passage tightens around the party. The Citadel answers according to how much of it has been disturbed.

options.label: Advance while the Citadel awakening is 0
Advance while the Citadel awakening is 1
Advance while the Citadel awakening is 2
Advance while the Citadel awakening is 3
Advance while the Citadel awakening is 4
Advance while the Citadel awakening is 5
Advance while the Citadel awakening is 6

scenes.title: The Heart of Teeth
scenes.text: The dungeon's organic masses converge on a circular heart ringed with tooth-like petals. It speaks through every doorway at once: 'I remember being a fortress. I remember being hungry.'

options.label: Offer it the iris lens and let it awaken

scenes.title: The Heart of Teeth — The Citadel Stirs
scenes.text: The Heart beats hard enough to flex the floor. Distant doors chatter like teeth; the Citadel is visibly waking. 'You have taught my nerves to remember motion,' it says.

options.label: Offer it the iris lens and let it awaken

scenes.title: The Heart of Teeth — Awakened Resistance
scenes.text: The Heart has thickened behind fresh plates of living stone. The chamber bites back at failed bindings; the Citadel is nearly awake.

options.label: Offer it the iris lens and let it awaken

scenes.title: The Maw Reinforces the Heart
scenes.text: At full awakening, the lower walls split and a fresh Brood of the Maw pours into the passage before the Heart.

scenes.title: The Citadel Rejects the Binding
scenes.text: The seal cracks. Every corridor clenches. The Heart tears itself free from the floor.

scenes.title: Ending — The Silent Ruin
scenes.text: The Heart splits. The fortress goes still one chamber at a time. You escape through the eastern arch as the fanged gate finally relaxes. What remains is only architecture—and the troubling knowledge that it once had a mind.

scenes.title: Ending — The Sleeper Rebound
scenes.text: The custodian seal burns into the Heart. Its pulse slows to one beat per hour. The dungeon survives, dormant and potentially useful, but someone must eventually become its next custodian.

scenes.title: Ending — The Citadel Walks
scenes.text: The iris lens sinks into the Heart. Far above, stone jaws open to the night. The entire buried structure heaves upward on forgotten limbs. You leave riding inside a newly awakened fortress whose intentions are not yet fully its own.
